text:
mia: Quick sync — SignalPath (SI) asked for a dev-friendly playbook to route SIEM alerts + traces into Datadog tile for their marketplace listing. Need final playbook + sample OTLP mapping + dashboard links in 2 weeks. Who can own?

alex: I can take playbook + sample OTLP mapping. Need list of required fields from SignalPath: alert schema, trace-span tags, preferred sampling and retention tiers.

jordan: I can draft the marketplace tile copy and a short customer-facing runbook. Will also wire up example dashboards.

samir: A few infra notes: confirm tracer SDK versions, export endpoints (hosted vs private), and whether Dedicated needs a VPN route. Also we must vet PII fields before shipping anything to a partner SIEM.

mia: @alex FYI SignalPath sent a minimal schema: model_id, request_id, latency_ms, error_type, user_prompt, user_id, env. They want alerts to map to Datadog events/alerts and span attributes to include model_id + request_id. Two retention tiers: short (30d) and long (365d).

alex: Copying the schema into an OTLP transform prototype — we'll redact user_prompt when pii=true and hash user_id. Sample mapping below:

alex: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model_id
        action: insert
      - key: request_id
        action: insert
      - key: user_id_hashed
        action: insert
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
    mapping:
      event.title: "{{ .attributes.model_id }} / alert"
      event.tags: ["env:${attributes.env}", "partner:signalpath"]
transformations:
  - redact: user_prompt
    when:
      attributes.pii: true
```

alex: We'll also add a route that stamps dd.alert.priority based on latency_ms thresholds.

jordan: For the marketplace tile, proposed bundle: 1) pre-built Datadog dashboard JSON, 2) alert rule templates, 3) onboarding runbook, 4) terraform module for marketplace deploy. Packaging as an OCI artifact + manifest ok?

samir: OCI + terraform is required for cloud marketplaces. For Private installs we need a separate package: helm chart + KMS keys handling doc. Test matrix should include Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved), and Private VPC.

claudia: I'll coordinate partner comms and book a kickoff with SignalPath + their SI lead. Suggest Thu 10:00am PT.

mia: Sounds good. Timeline: week 1 — draft mapping + dashboards; week 2 — internal review + partner review + preflight. Action owners: alex (mapping & playbook), jordan (tile copy & dashboard), samir (packaging & test matrix), claudia (partner comms).

ops-bot: Preflight queued: infra-lint ✔, dashboard-schema-validate queued, datadog-schema-check queued.

alex: I'll open the PR by Friday with mapping + sample dashboards and link the preflight.

mia: Thanks everyone — will add owners to the doc and drop SignalPath invite. Short action list in the doc: 1) OTLP mapping PR (alex) 2) Dashboard JSON + sample alerts (jordan) 3) Packaging spec + test matrix (samir) 4) Partner kickoff + timeline (claudia).

jordan: Small ask — include an example alert title pattern `model:<model_id> latency>500ms` so their support UX is clean.

alex: noted. Will add.

mia: Closing for now, will follow up after kickoff. :calendar:
